user_questions.question: What should 'make them useful' mean for Storefront tags? Today Storefront_Tag__c has only a free-text Name (label 'Tag') and a Storefront__c lookup, with 0 records. Options: (a) a controlled tag vocabulary (picklist) on Storefront_Tag__c; (b) a way to filter/find storefronts by tag; (c) show tags on the storefront record page; (d) something else. If (a), which tag values? Recommendation: (a)+(b).
user_questions.simulated_answer: Tag picklist (Vegan, Late Night, Family Friendly, Halal, Kosher) on Storefront Tag and ability to filter storefronts by tag.

skill_friction: Entry check says ask a clarifying question before AskCoworker for vague requirements, while step 5 says ask only after D1 and allows up to one more message only for new intent forks. It is unclear whether the entry clarification consumes the single step-5 question message; I treated it as the one allowed message and decided the filter mechanism (report vs list view vs LWC) myself.

The org-verification reference says object settings like Allow Reports are readable via Tooling CustomObject.Metadata queried by Id, but this org rejected the Metadata column on CustomObject; the report row had to become Conditional with a blocking item.
The validator's Section 4 bullet regex rejects a parenthetical type after the bolded API name (e.g. '**Create `X`** (ReportFolder) —'), which spec-format.md does not document.
spec-format says folder-scoped reports go under reports/<Folder>/ but does not say what Module path a ReportFolder uses; I used the same reports/<Folder> path.

Guidance on whether a new picklist should be universally required conflicts with least-privilege FLS guidance (universally required fields cannot be FLS-restricted); the skill does not address this trade-off.
